decisions.reason: Its move from a simple mention to its own page suggests results above the firm's aspiration level, and it strengthens the core floor-care system.

Although it did not gain stronger prominence, it remains a close complement to the installed base of wood floors, and in a growing market with organisational slack it is reasonable to retain it while monitoring performance.
Its upgrade to a dedicated page indicates encouraging acceptance relative to aspiration, and it fits the firm's strategy of offering complete care solutions for oiled floors.

Even without expanded visibility, it supports the firm's system-selling logic for flooring installations, and there is no clear sign of performance falling far enough below aspiration to justify withdrawal.

As an adjacent installation accessory it likely contributes to a complete range for trade buyers, and the firm's current slack and growth make continued market presence a defensible choice despite limited visibility.
This product is very close to the firm's core business, so unless results were clearly unsatisfactory management would usually keep it and exploit existing production, sales, and brand capabilities.
